info.title: Tuck API
info.description:
Open-source Kubernetes-native secrets manager. Single binary, no external DB.

**Auth:** Set `X-Tuck-Token` header on all requests except those marked `security: []`.

**LIST method:** Endpoints that enumerate keys use the non-standard `LIST` HTTP verb. In curl: `curl -X LIST`. In the spec these are represented as `get` operations on paths ending in `/`.

peers.description: Per-follower observations; present only while this node is the leader

last_contact_ms.description: Age of the last contact with the leader; null on the leader

capabilities.description: Bitmask: read=1, write=2, delete=4, list=8, sudo=16, deny=32

KVAuthor.description: Who wrote a version. Never contains the token itself; absent for versions written before authorship was recorded.

oldest_version.description: Lowest version still stored; versions below it were evicted by max_versions

cas_required_effective.description: cas_required of the secret or of the mount

KVMetaUpdate.description: Fields that are present are applied. custom_metadata replaces the map on PUT and is merged on PATCH (a null value deletes a key). Limits: 64 pairs, keys up to 128 bytes, values up to 512 bytes, max_versions 0..1000.

KVListEntry.description: Metadata only, never values. For entries the token may not read (restricted) only name/folder/restricted are set.

count.description: Folders: number of secrets below, recursively

hidden.description: Secrets the token may list but not read; not included in the other counts

tuck_namespace.description: Bound Tuck namespace; empty = root / unbound

updated_at.description: Last metadata update; absent until the first PUT

NamespaceMetadata.description: Editable, non-secret namespace metadata. PUT replaces all three fields.

NamespaceStats.description: Object counts of one namespace. A field is absent when the caller may not list the objects it counts (never zero in that case).

tokens.description: Live tokens bound to the namespace

auth_roles.description: AppRole + JWT + LDAP roles bound to the namespace (Kubernetes roles are not counted)

truncated.description: A scan limit cut the token count short

MountStats.description: Usage counters of one mount, computed for the caller's namespace. Fields are absent when they do not apply or the caller may not list what they count.

engine_backed.description: false for a mount-table-only entry: nothing is stored under it, removing it deletes no data

versions.description: KV v2 version records, including deleted and destroyed

hidden_secrets.description: KV v2 secrets whose metadata the caller may not read; left out of the version figures

truncated.description: More secrets than the scan limit; version figures are partial

config.description: Optional KV v2 tuning options, accepted only when creating the secret/ mount (the only mount wired to the KV v2 engine); same validation as POST .../mounts-tune. Omit for every other mount.

max_versions.description: KV v2 only (secret/ mount): default max_versions of new secrets, 0 = built-in 10

cas_required.description: KV v2 only (secret/ mount): every write must carry cas

WrappedCapsule.description: Metadata of a live wrapped response. Never contains the wrapping token or the payload; the accessor cannot be used to unwrap.

post.summary: Replace the data of the whole Raft cluster with a snapshot
post.description: Body: a snapshot downloaded from GET /v1/sys/snapshot or /v1/sys/cluster/snapshot/{id}. Requires ?confirm=true. Leader only, root namespace only. Every node seals itself afterwards and must be unsealed with the key shares of the cluster the snapshot came from. Tokens and secrets written after the snapshot are lost.

400.description: Missing confirm, or not a Tuck snapshot
